recentItems.title: One of Darwin’s oldest soccer clubs helping to connect migrants from more than 30 nations | ABC NEWS
recentItems.description:
For generations, sport has been a way for new arrivals to connect in Australia. In Darwin, one of the city's oldest football clubs is helping a new wave of migrants find belonging. The Darwin Olympic soccer club has players from 40 different nationalities, and it's vying for grand final honours. By Anzaya Karim for ABC News Northern Territory.

recentItems.description:

recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: Australian woman dies after falling from cliff at a popular tourist spot in Bali | ABC NEWS
recentItems.description:
An Australian woman has died after falling from a popular beach cliff near Bali.
Twenty-nine-year-old Brianna Cronin from Queensland became stranded on the steep cliff on Nusa Penida island.
Local authorities say the alarm was raised and help was on the way, but she lost her footing before rescuers arrived.

recentItems.title: Man charged after alleged carjacking pursuit in Sydney's west | ABC NEWS
recentItems.description:
Warning: This video contains images that may disturb some viewers.
 
New South Wales Police have thanked three members of the public for helping to arrest a man accused of a carjacking and collision in Sydney's west on Saturday.
 
It's alleged the 36-year-old, who was driving with his two children, collided with another car on Parramatta Road at Lidcombe and then stole a woman's car.
 
He was later arrested by an off-duty police officer.
 
Inspector Mark Wakeham from Auburn Police Area Command had this update.
